false_positive_modes: A property can leave a later list after payment, a payment plan, an exemption, a correction, or a program-level cancellation; the dataset does not identify which lever applied.
The list records BBL progression, not owner intent, debt amount, later foreclosure, or title transfer.
Publication is irregular; an expired cycle is historical context, not a current warning.
